reviewed_prior_scope: guide factorized and physical-beta coefficient-history source pilots
complex affine response with/without global DC
novelty: Within these reviewed packages, no continuous spatial-frequency/sub-bin nonlinear atom refinement with held-out observable selection has been tested. Previous source phase models rotate fixed integer DFT bins; guide models estimate linear coefficients; response regressions operate at fixed bins. This is not an exhaustive repository-wide claim.
bounded_next_hypothesis: A coherent source component with noninteger spatial frequency can leak across hundreds of DFT bins. Fit a few continuous-frequency sine/cosine atoms with shared spatial frequency and separate RGB coefficients to past source observations, select or reject using held-out observed samples, then predict current atom coefficients causally and leave unrepresented detail to an unchanged residual pilot. First feasibility must measure atom+residual reconstruction and absolute every-frame texture/phase; no saved native T(P) may be reused for changed P.
risk_before_registration: Dense material may contain genuine detail requiring many modes; low-dimensional atom projection alone can erase it
Held-out pixels/times are not proven independent under colored/spatial/temporal or shared noise
Frequency selection/refinement has nonlinear multiple-selection bias and can fit persistent source bias
Nearly coincident frequencies and phase/frequency drift are ill-conditioned
Acceleration/disocclusion cannot be explained by a stationary harmonic atom history
Residual treatment can retain old support churn/noise or remove real weak texture
Guide-independent source fitting cannot distinguish persistent artifact from true material
A native response to this changed P must be measured fresh after source-only feasibility
evidence_motivation: Mature material/wave used-phase counts0 and innovation rare/0; changing hard support is substantial, with nonzero component covariance. Same-P native scatter small/0 and shared source P variation dominant. These descriptive findings motivate testing representation continuity; they do not prove an off-grid harmonic cause or expected solution.
